items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: Matthew was a trumpet player that played around here with Charlie Johnson and different bands, you know.

ctx.x: Matthew was a trumpet player that played around here with Charlie Johnson and different bands, you know.

And then he finally dropped out of sight. I don't know what happened to him. I used to see him years ago. He left Horace, and then let's see, had him, and this guy I told you, Bernice Morton, and Roy. And that was the trumpet section of Horace Henderson's band. And so he left, Red left, Red Holland left, and then they sent for me. So I come into the band and then there was me and Bernice Morton and Roy.
